papers.title: Cutting the Cord: System Architecture for Low-Cost, GPU-Accelerated Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Extends XLeRobot with onboard Jetson computation, revised power distribution and stiffer arm components for untethered teleoperation, navigation and vision-guided manipulation.
papers.summary_zh: 为 XLeRobot 加入板载 Jetson 计算、改进供电分配和刚度更高的机械臂部件，用于不拖线的遥操作、导航与视觉引导操作。

papers.title: Nori Bot: A Sub-$1,000 Floor-to-Counter Mobile Manipulator
papers.summary_en: The original Nori Bot prototype adds a vertical lift to an XLeRobot-based cart to extend its manipulation workspace. This is the historical v1 design; the later Nori A3 in v2 uses a different mechanical base.
papers.summary_zh: 早期 Nori Bot 原型在基于 XLeRobot 的小车上加入升降轴，以扩展操作空间。此处收录历史 v1 设计；后续 v2 的 Nori A3 使用不同的机械底座。

papers.title: AnchorVLA4D: an Anchor-Based Spatial-Temporal Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Uses XLeRobot to evaluate an anchor-image vision-language-action policy on box lifting, drawer opening and pouring, with task-specific demonstrations collected on the robot.
papers.summary_zh: 使用 XLeRobot 评估引入锚点图像的视觉语言动作策略，在机器人上采集任务演示，并开展抬箱、开抽屉和倒水实验。

papers.title: Teaching Tiny VLA Models Where to Look and How to Move
papers.summary_en: Uses XLeRobot for a bimanual carrot-handover task with demonstrations collected from several teleoperators. Appendix D of v3 presents a qualitative comparison of XS-VLA, ACT and SmolVLA using partial-credit scores.
papers.summary_zh: 使用 XLeRobot 开展双臂胡萝卜传递任务，并由多位操作员采集遥操作演示。v3 附录 D 以分阶段计分方式定性比较 XS-VLA、ACT 和 SmolVLA。

papers.title: MARS-RA: Rank Aggregation for Credit Assignment via Multimodal Comparisons in Embodied Multi-Agent Cooperation
papers.summary_en: Tests a multi-agent coordination policy on two XLeRobots in a cooperative doorway-traversal task, after training in a reconstructed simulation of the room.
papers.summary_zh: 先在重建的房间仿真场景中训练多智能体协作策略，再使用两台 XLeRobot 开展协同穿门的真机实验。

papers.title: Low-Cost Teleoperation Extension for Mobile Manipulators
papers.summary_en: Combines phone-based head tracking, foot-pedal base control and leader arms in an XLeRobot teleoperation interface. A 30-participant study compares the interface with keyboard and headset-based alternatives.
papers.summary_zh: 在 XLeRobot 遥操作界面中结合手机头部追踪、脚踏板底盘控制和主从机械臂。论文通过 30 人用户研究，将这一界面与键盘和头显方案进行比较。

papers.title: LeHome: A Simulation Environment for Deformable Object Manipulation in Household Scenarios
papers.summary_en: Integrates an XLeRobot embodiment into a household simulation environment for deformable-object manipulation, with keyboard and joystick teleoperation for collecting demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh: 在面向家居可变形物体操作的仿真环境中接入 XLeRobot 本体，并提供键盘和手柄遥操作以采集演示。

papers.title: PIPHEN: Physical Interaction Prediction with Hamiltonian Energy Networks
papers.summary_en: Deploys a distributed perception-and-control method on two single-arm XLeRobot mobile manipulators for a coordinated table-setting demonstration.
papers.summary_zh: 将分布式感知与控制方法部署到两台单臂改型 XLeRobot 移动机器人上，开展协同摆放餐具演示。

papers.title: ElasticFlow: One-Step Physics-Consistent Policy with Elastic Time Horizons for Language-Guided Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Presents qualitative XLeRobot demonstrations of intercepting a rolling cylinder, inserting a straw and executing a multi-stage household manipulation sequence.
papers.summary_zh: 使用 XLeRobot 定性展示拦截滚动圆柱、插入吸管和执行多阶段家居操作序列。

projects.title: RoboCrew
projects.summary_en: Adds LLM-driven interaction to XLeRobot through camera observations, speech, arm-control tools, and multi-agent examples.
projects.summary_zh: 为 XLeRobot 接入基于大语言模型的交互，提供相机观察、语音、机械臂控制工具及多智能体示例。
projects.evidence_note: README includes XLeRobot-specific imports and runnable speech, manipulation, and cooperation examples.

projects.title: MakerMods XLeRobot
projects.summary_en: Redesigns XLeRobot's printed structure, wheel modules, power-bank mounts, and electronics enclosures, with shared CAD and printing files.
projects.summary_zh: 重新设计 XLeRobot 的打印结构、轮组、充电宝支架和电子部件外壳，并提供 CAD 与打印文件。
projects.evidence_note: README describes concrete modified parts and supplies design files; commercial collaborator of the original author. Fleet and reliability claims omitted.

projects.title: XLeRobot Home Service Demo
projects.summary_en: Demonstrates a modified XLeRobot responding to spoken requests and fetching objects, with calibration tools, ACT and geometric grasping backends, and voice/web interfaces.
projects.summary_zh: 展示改装 XLeRobot 响应语音请求并取送物品，提供标定工具、ACT 与几何抓取方案，以及语音和网页接口。
projects.evidence_note: README documents the reference build, implementation, videos, model, and dataset. The cover image is explicitly a URDF visualization, not a photograph.

projects.title: Maque
projects.summary_en: Connects a local language-model agent, VLA executor, and XLeRobot controller across three computers, with an Orange Pi robot host.
projects.summary_zh: 将本地语言模型智能体、VLA 执行端和 XLeRobot 控制端部署在三台计算设备上，由 Orange Pi 承载机器人端。
projects.evidence_note: README describes the implemented three-machine stack and XLeRobot robot endpoint; no task success or latency claims retained.

projects.title: XLeRobot Servo MCP Server
projects.summary_en: Exposes XLeRobot's servo and wheel controls to MCP clients through RoboCrew's controller, with hardware and mock backends.
projects.summary_zh: 通过 RoboCrew 控制器向 MCP 客户端开放 XLeRobot 的舵机与车轮控制，并提供硬件和模拟后端。
projects.evidence_note: README supplies explicit hardware invocation with serial buses and distinguishes it from mock mode.

projects.title: QWEN-XLeRobot
projects.summary_en: Integrates Qwen voice interaction with XLeRobot, including playback of recorded arm motions and visual scene descriptions.
projects.summary_zh: 为 XLeRobot 集成通义语音交互、已录制机械臂动作的回放及视觉场景描述。
projects.evidence_note: README explicitly identifies the integration; robot/robot_controller.py contains real dual-arm LeRobot connections. Do not infer navigation or full-body autonomous control.

projects.title: XLeRobot-dev
projects.summary_en: Extends XLeRobot on an RDK S100 with a vision-and-speech agent, mobile-base control, and persistent USB-device mappings.
projects.summary_zh: 在 RDK S100 上扩展 XLeRobot，加入视觉语音智能体、移动底盘控制和固定 USB 设备路径。
projects.evidence_note: README distinguishes implemented robocrew/voice_agent/llm_move_agent code from future imitation-learning and sim-to-real plans; only implemented scope retained.

projects.title: XLeRobot Pinc
projects.summary_en: Extends XLeRobot with SO107-style arms and PincOpen grippers, sharing hardware designs, URDF models, and teleoperation interfaces.
projects.summary_zh: 为 XLeRobot 配置 SO107 风格机械臂与 PincOpen 夹爪，并开放硬件设计、URDF 模型和遥操作接口。
projects.evidence_note: README explicitly establishes XLeRobot lineage, custom hardware, robot classes, and runnable examples.

projects.title: XLerobot-X1
projects.summary_en: Adapts XLeRobot to a Qualcomm QCS8550 computing platform, with assembly, wiring, printed-part, and software resources.
projects.summary_zh: 将 XLeRobot 适配到高通 QCS8550 计算平台，提供装配、接线、打印零件和软件资源。
projects.evidence_note: README identifies the Qualcomm version of XLeRobot and its code/design resources. Unsupported payload, safety, cost, and reliability language omitted.

projects.title: XLeRobot-Pro Measurement Tools
projects.summary_en: Shares measurement scripts, experiment protocols, and telemetry for an XLeRobot-Pro build, covering power, actuator temperature, payload motion, and demonstration recording.
projects.summary_zh: 提供 XLeRobot-Pro 的测量脚本、实验流程与遥测数据，涵盖供电、执行器温度、负载运动及示教录制。
projects.evidence_note: README lists concrete scripts and links the operating-code repository. Published measurements were not independently reproduced and are not quoted here.

projects.title: XLeRobot Mecanum Control
projects.summary_en: Adds keyboard driving and a spatial-tracking controller for a four-wheel mecanum XLeRobot base through LeRobot's XLeRobot interface.
projects.summary_zh: 通过 LeRobot 的 XLeRobot 接口，为四轮麦克纳姆底盘增加键盘驾驶与空间位置跟随控制器。
projects.evidence_note: README names keyboard_drive.py and mecanum_base.py, servo IDs, and the XLeRobot interface; no tracking-accuracy or safety guarantee retained.

projects.title: Grievous
projects.summary_en: Extends an XLeRobot build with onboard SO-101 leader arms and reports SmolVLA experiments on pick-and-place and dusting tasks.
projects.summary_zh: 在 XLeRobot 上增加随车 SO-101 主臂，并展示 SmolVLA 在抓放和除尘任务中的实验进展。
projects.evidence_note: Author's project page explicitly identifies the XLeRobot base and completed modification; demonstration progress is not a task benchmark.

projects.title: XLeRobot IsaacLab
projects.summary_en: Provides an IsaacLab extension for XLeRobot with keyboard/gamepad teleoperation and ground-plane, cube-lifting, and loft environments.
projects.summary_zh: 提供 XLeRobot 的 IsaacLab 扩展，包含键盘与手柄遥操作，以及地面、抬升方块和室内场景环境。
projects.evidence_note: README lists registered XLeRobot environments, robot assets, device drivers, and launch scripts. This is simulation integration.

projects.title: XLeRobot Isaac Sim on DGX Spark
projects.summary_en: Adapts XLeRobot's IsaacLab simulation to DGX Spark, with environment assets, teleoperation, and LeRobot/GR00T workflow scripts.
projects.summary_zh: 将 XLeRobot 的 IsaacLab 仿真适配到 DGX Spark，提供环境资产、遥操作和 LeRobot／GR00T 工作流脚本。
projects.evidence_note: README documents XLeRobot simulation fixes and assets. Its real-hardware deployment section targets SO-101, so no full-XLeRobot sim-to-real result is claimed.

projects.title: XLeRobot Gazebo
projects.summary_en: Integrates XLeRobot with Gazebo and ros2_control, including launch scripts for omnidirectional and planar base backends.
projects.summary_zh: 将 XLeRobot 接入 Gazebo 与 ros2_control，提供全向和二维平面底盘后端的启动脚本。
projects.evidence_note: README identifies the XLeRobot-specific Gazebo package, robot assets, and concrete GUI/headless commands.

projects.title: XLeRobot ROS 2 Jazzy
projects.summary_en: Provides ROS 2 drivers and teleoperation for XLeRobot's arms, head, and base, including gamepad and leader–follower control.
projects.summary_zh: 为 XLeRobot 的双臂、头部和底盘提供 ROS 2 驱动，并支持手柄及主从臂遥操作。
projects.evidence_note: README specifies hardware bus ownership, driver topics, bundled XLeRobot adapters, and implemented teleoperation packages; mock mode is separate.

projects.title: XLeRobot ROS 2 Humble
projects.summary_en: Connects XLeRobot to ROS 2 and MoveIt through a hardware bridge, with robot models, calibration tools, and joint/base control.
projects.summary_zh: 通过硬件桥接将 XLeRobot 接入 ROS 2 和 MoveIt，提供机器人模型、标定工具及关节和底盘控制。
projects.evidence_note: Lowercase readme.md documents real-hardware launch, two serial buses, MoveIt configuration, and hardware bridge. Separate AlohaX platform is excluded.

projects.title: LiveKit Portal for XLeRobot
projects.summary_en: Implements remote bimanual leader-arm teleoperation for XLeRobot over LiveKit Portal, with camera streaming, Rerun visualization, and LeRobot dataset recording.
projects.summary_zh: 通过 LiveKit Portal 实现 XLeRobot 双主臂远程遥操作，并集成相机流、Rerun 可视化和 LeRobot 数据录制。
projects.evidence_note: README documents robot/operator machines, XLeRobot driver installation, serial/camera configuration, and recording.

projects.title: XLVR
projects.summary_en: Extends XLeRobot's XLeVR stack with a Quest 3 delta-control IK bridge for single- or dual-arm SO-101 teleoperation.
projects.summary_zh: 扩展 XLeRobot 的 XLeVR 系统，加入面向 Quest 3 的增量控制逆运动学桥接，支持单臂或双臂 SO-101 遥操作。
projects.evidence_note: README explicitly imports upstream XLeVR/VRMonitor and supplies arm control workflow. Scope is arm teleoperation, not validated mobile-base control.

projects.title: XLeRobot over XoQ
projects.summary_en: Teleoperates a dual-SO-100 XLeRobot configuration and differential-drive base through XoQ's remote serial bridge.
projects.summary_zh: 通过 XoQ 远程串口桥接，对双 SO-100 机械臂和差速底盘的 XLeRobot 配置进行遥操作。
projects.evidence_note: README documents serial services, arm/base wiring, persisted peer identities, and client scripts.

projects.title: Pounce
projects.summary_en: Adds Rift S/SteamVR teleoperation for XLeRobot's arms, four-wheel base, and camera gimbal, alongside STS servo configuration tools.
projects.summary_zh: 使用 Rift S／SteamVR 遥操作 XLeRobot 的双臂、四轮底盘和相机云台，并提供 STS 舵机配置工具。
projects.evidence_note: README identifies XLeRobot hardware, clutch-driven control, actual bus mappings, application packaging, and hardware-specific configuration.

projects.title: XLeRobot Joy-Con Data Collection
projects.summary_en: Provides Joy-Con teleoperation and demonstration-recording scripts for XLeRobot, alongside a pi0.5 training workflow.
projects.summary_zh: 提供 XLeRobot 的 Joy-Con 遥操作与示教数据录制脚本，并包含 pi0.5 训练工作流。
projects.evidence_note: README is short; repository tree additionally confirms joycon controllers, XLeRobot host/client modules, and xlerobot-joycon-dataset.sh. No trained-policy performance claimed.

projects.title: XLeRobot Remote Joy-Con Control
projects.summary_en: Implements remote Joy-Con control of XLeRobot's two arms, head, and mobile base, including base acceleration and deceleration handling.
projects.summary_zh: 实现 Joy-Con 对 XLeRobot 双臂、头部和移动底盘的远程控制，并加入底盘加减速处理。
projects.evidence_note: Generic root README alone is insufficient; checked examples/9_teleoperate_joycon_remote.py imports XLerobotClient, maps both arms/head, and sends combined base actions.

projects.title: XLeRobot Kinesthetic Recorder
projects.summary_en: Records demonstrations by manually guiding XLeRobot's follower arms, with synchronized camera recording and replay tools.
projects.summary_zh: 通过手动引导 XLeRobot 从臂录制示教，提供同步相机录制与回放工具。
projects.evidence_note: README documents follower-only dual-arm setup, recorder script, and cameras; excludes unverified claims about cost or learning improvement.

projects.title: XLeRobot WebXR
projects.summary_en: Implements the WebXR client and Mac proxy for an XLeRobot dual-arm teleoperation project, with simulator command interfaces and diagnostic tools.
projects.summary_zh: 实现 XLeRobot 双臂遥操作项目的 WebXR 客户端和 Mac 代理，包含仿真指令接口及诊断工具。
projects.evidence_note: Capstone repository README documents implemented client/proxy files and simulator targets. Do not present it as a completed physical-robot user study.

projects.title: Dexbotic XLeRobot Integration
projects.summary_en: Provides an XLeRobot-specific path from LeRobot data conversion to policy training and deployment, using a robot client, inference bridge, and policy server.
projects.summary_zh: 提供面向 XLeRobot 的 LeRobot 数据转换、策略训练和部署流程，通过机器人客户端、推理桥接与策略服务器连接各环节。
projects.evidence_note: Checked hardware/docs/xlerobot_inference_example.md: explicit v0.4 two-wheel embodiment, 16D action schema, converter, bridge.py, and deployment commands.

projects.title: BrainBot
projects.summary_en: Builds an XLeRobot control stack that combines bimanual teleoperation, policy inference, multi-camera streaming, and web/AR visualization.
projects.summary_zh: 构建面向 XLeRobot 的控制系统，整合双臂遥操作、策略推理、多相机流及网页／AR 可视化。
projects.evidence_note: README supplies actual XLeRobot robot/leader configurations and links the team's Hackster project. No benchmark or promised future dataset claimed.

projects.title: Laundry Bot
projects.summary_en: Implements a towel-folding policy pipeline for XLeRobot using GR00T and LeRobot, with modality configuration and a phase-based robot evaluation script.
projects.summary_zh: 基于 GR00T 与 LeRobot 实现 XLeRobot 叠毛巾策略流程，提供模态配置和按阶段执行的机器人评估脚本。
projects.evidence_note: README explicitly lists xle_data_config.py and eval_xle.py for the real XLeRobot. This establishes code, not a verified folding success rate.

projects.title: Vesalius-Ai XLeRobot Teleoperation
projects.summary_en: Provides desktop-to-Jetson XLeRobot teleoperation with leader arms, camera streaming, IMU yaw tracking, and demonstration recording.
projects.summary_zh: 提供从桌面电脑到 Jetson 的 XLeRobot 主臂遥操作，集成相机流、IMU 航向跟踪与示教录制。
projects.evidence_note: README now available and documents actual XLeRobot host/client files and deployment. The owner's surgical-assistant repository description is not reused; no medical capability claimed.

projects.title: OneRobotAI XLeRobot
projects.summary_en: Shares an XLeRobot adaptation with a SmolVLA towel-folding demonstration.
projects.summary_zh: 分享 XLeRobot 的适配代码及 SmolVLA 叠毛巾演示。
projects.evidence_note: Root README links its own fold_tower.mp4 demonstration. Retained as a modified application fork, not merely an upstream mirror; no trial-level performance inferred.

projects.title: XLeRobot Perception Engine
projects.summary_en: Adds object tracking and camera-head sweeping to XLeRobot, with a pan/tilt controller, calibration utility, and browser preview.
projects.summary_zh: 为 XLeRobot 增加目标跟踪与相机云台扫视，提供俯仰／偏航控制器、标定工具和浏览器预览。
projects.evidence_note: README separates implemented XLERobotHead, tracking controller, real Feetech/camera backend, and mock mode.

projects.title: XLeRobot Hackathon Tools
projects.summary_en: Shares XLeRobot-focused policy-training and perception tools from a hackathon project, plus a companion installer that configures the LeRobot/XLeRobot integration.
projects.summary_zh: 分享黑客松项目中面向 XLeRobot 的策略训练与感知工具，并通过配套安装器配置 LeRobot 和 XLeRobot 的集成。
projects.evidence_note: xle-hack README documents trainer/data/perception code; xlerobot-onboard README supplies an implemented pinned-version installer. Grouped as one developer/event case, not two adoptions.

projects.title: Clemson Student Interaction Robot
projects.summary_en: A Clemson student project built an XLeRobot with Jetson AGX Orin, a microphone, and a speaker for language-based human–robot interaction.
projects.summary_zh: Clemson 学生项目搭建 XLeRobot，并加入 Jetson AGX Orin、麦克风和扬声器，用于语言式人机交互。
projects.evidence_note: Previously verified primary university programme, PDF page 105, poster 303, Christian Passios and Jonathan Tran. Completed build described in an abstract; no learning outcomes or controlled evaluation asserted.

projects.title: Matcha Bot
projects.summary_en: UIUC SIGRobotics adapted XLeRobot for matcha preparation, combining bimanual control with a GR00T N1.5 policy and sharing its project code.
projects.summary_zh: UIUC SIGRobotics 将 XLeRobot 用于抹茶制作，结合双臂控制与 GR00T N1.5 策略，并开放项目代码。
projects.evidence_note: Previously verified primary team project report and code links. Describes a modified XLeRobot demonstration, not a repeated-trial benchmark or measured educational benefit.
